name: Customize Place Order & Add to cart Button for Woocommerce
author: Appsfruit

sections.description:
Easily customize the ‘Place Order’ and ‘Add to Cart’ button texts in WooCommerce from your admin panel—no coding required.

Features

  • Easy to Use: Quickly change the “Place Order” and “Add to Cart” button texts from the WooCommerce settings menu.
  • Seamless Integration: Works out of the box with WooCommerce.
  • No Coding Required: Change the button texts without touching a single line of code.
  • Lightweight: Designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance.

Usage

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Customize Buttons in your WordPress admin.
  2. Enter the new texts you want for the “Place Order” and “Add to Cart” buttons.
  3. Click Save Changes.
  4. The “Place Order” and “Add to Cart” buttons on your WooCommerce store will now display your custom texts.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the customize-place-order-add-to-cart-button-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Customize Buttons in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your desired texts and save.
sections.faq:
Can I revert to the default “Place Order” and “Add to Cart” texts?

Yes! Simply remove the custom texts from the input fields and save the settings. The buttons will revert to their default WooCommerce texts.

Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. It only modifies the button texts, leaving your theme’s design intact.

Is there a performance impact?

No, this plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only modifies the button texts and does not add any significant load to your site.
